mission_02: Z-score standardization (also called standard scaling) transforms data to have a mean of 0 and standard deviation of 1. Unlike min-max scaling, z-score standardization does not bound values to a specific range, making it more robust to new data points outside the training range. It is the preferred scaling method for many machine learning algorithms including linear regression, logistic regression, and principal component analysis. In this mission, you will implement z-score standardization from scratch using the formula z = (x - mean) / std.
